result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, with the oldest first inside each priority. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the new order, so your T-1 to T-5 example isn't covered by one.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Its `ORDER BY` now uses the same priority ordering as the sales-rep list, and I updated the method's comment to match. Closed tickets and tickets from other regions are filtered out exactly as before. I haven't committed anything.
